1-MODUL O'Z-O'ZINI BAHOLASH, IKKINCHI BET (33-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda to'q yashil 'Module Self-Assessment 1' va qora '(Units 1 - 4)'.

CHAP USTUN:
• 5-mashqning davomi: 7 - 10 gaplar. '(10 marks)'.
6) 'Number the adjectives in the correct order.' Beshta gap; sifatlar QALIN harflarda va har birining yonida qavs. '(5 marks)'.
7) 'Complete the sentences with adjectives from the list, in comparative or superlative form.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: short, long, bad, expensive, young. Beshta qisqa dialog (A va B). '(5 marks)'.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: Buying Things' sarlavhasi.
8) 'Match the questions (1 - 5) to the replies (a - e).' Beshta savol va beshta javob (a - e), har birining oldida KATAKChA. '(5 marks)'.

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Reading' sarlavhasi.
9) 'Read the beginning (a) and ending (b) of a story, and put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or past continuous, then answer the questions.' Ikki qism: a) 1-8 bo'shliq; b) 9-15 bo'shliq. '(15 marks)'. Ostida sakkizta savol ikki ustunda. '(8 marks)'.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' sarlavhasi.
10) 'The pictures below show the beginning and ending of a story. Use the prompts to help you write a beginning and ending.'
Ikkita SURAT:
• yuqorida - yig'ilish xonasida stol atrofidagi odamlar (Mr Yang va xodimlar); yonida qog'ozda ko'rsatmalar
• pastda - ko'zoynakli erkak (Mr Yang) ayolga (Miss Wong) OQ GULDASTA uzatmoqda; yonida qog'ozda ko'rsatmalar
'(14 marks)'
Eng pastda: 'TOTAL: 100 marks'.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '33'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past continuous. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
5-MAShQNING DAVOMI (32-betdan).


HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  7  'last night' - TUGAGAN vaqt →
     PAST SIMPLE so'roq: 'DID you
     WATCH ...?'

  8  'last night' → PAST SIMPLE:
     'Steve HELPED me.'

  9  TASVIR (qanday kiyingan edi) →
     PAST CONTINUOUS: 'The man WAS
     WEARING an expensive suit.'
     ⚠ 'and HAD a beard' - 'have' HOLAT
     fe'li, shuning uchun SIMPLE.

  10 'when the doorbell rang' - qisqa
     ish uzun ishni bo'ldi →
     PAST CONTINUOUS: 'She WAS PLAYING
     the piano.'


⚠ 7-BAND - SO'ROQ ShAKLI:

  'DID you WATCH ...?'
  ⚠ 'did' dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
  ⚠ 'Did you watched' - XATO.


⚠ 9-BANDDA IKKI ZAMON BIR GAPDA:

  'The man WAS WEARING an expensive
   suit and HAD a beard and moustache.'

  ⚠ 'wear' - harakat → CONTINUOUS
  ⚠ 'have' (egalik) - HOLAT → SIMPLE

  ⚠ Bu - juda muhim farq.


⚠ 10-BAND - 4-UNIT QOLIPI:

  UZUN ish (was playing) + QISQA ish
  (rang) = 17-mashqning 'c'
  qo'llanishi (29-bet).


⚠ 'TO PLAY THE PIANO':

  ⚠ Cholg'u oldidan 'THE' ShART:
  'play THE piano', 'play THE guitar'.
  ⚠ Sport oldidan artikl YO'Q:
  'play football'.

items.textEn: 7  ___ (you/watch) that film on TV last night?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'last night' - TUGAGAN vaqt → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ SO'ROQDA 'did' + fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
⚠ Gap boshida bo'lgani uchun KATTA harf.

items.textEn: 8  Steve ___ (help) me with my homework last night.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'last night' → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'to help sb WITH sth' - predlog 'with'.
⚠ 'help' - TO'G'RI fe'l: helped.

items.textEn: 9  The man ___ (wear) an expensive suit and had a beard and moustache.
items.whyUz:
⚠ TASVIR → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ DIQQAT: gapdagi ikkinchi fe'l 'HAD' - SIMPLE,
chunki 'have' (egalik) HOLAT fe'li.
⚠ Bir gapda ikki zamon - bu NORMAL.

items.textEn: 10  She ___ (play) the piano when the doorbell rang.
items.whyUz:
⚠ UZUN ish → PAST CONTINUOUS;
'when' dan keyin QISQA ish ('rang').
⚠ 29-betdagi 17-mashqning 'c' qo'llanishi.
⚠ 'play THE piano' - cholg'u oldidan 'the' ShART.

exercises.instructionEn: Number the adjectives in the correct order. (5 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
3-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI
(20-betdagi qoida).


⚠ TARTIB:

  FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK → ShAKL →
  RANG → MATERIAL → OT


HAR BANDNING TAHLILI:

  1  small (o'lcham) = 1
     triangular (shakl) = 2
     gold (material) = 3
     → 'small triangular gold earrings'

  2  pretty (fikr) = 1
     pink (rang) = 2
     woollen (material) = 3
     → 'a pretty pink woollen jumper'

  3  expensive (fikr) = 1
     brown (rang) = 2
     leather (material) = 3
     → 'expensive brown leather shoes'

  4  nice (fikr) = 1
     black (rang) = 2
     velvet (material) = 3
     → 'a nice black velvet dress'

  5  small (o'lcham) = 1
     blue (rang) = 2
     plastic (material) = 3
     → 'a small blue plastic bag'


⚠ HAR BANDDA MATERIAL OXIRIDA:

  gold, woollen, leather, velvet,
  plastic - hammasi OTGA ENG YaQIN.

  ⚠ Bu - eng oson eslab qolinadigan
  qoida.


⚠ 1-BANDDA FIKR SIFATI YO'Q:

  'small triangular gold' - uchalasi
  ham FACT sifatlari.
  ⚠ Shuning uchun tartib: o'lcham →
  shakl → material.


⚠ 'EARRINGS':

  = sirg'alar.
  ⚠ 'ear' (quloq) + 'ring' (uzuk).
  ⚠ HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA (juftlik).


⚠ 'VELVET':

  = baxmal.
  ⚠ 20-betdagi material ro'yxatida ham
  bor edi.
exercises.exampleEn: I can't find my small triangular gold earrings.
modelAnswers: I can't find my small triangular gold earrings.
She's wearing a pretty pink woollen jumper.
He bought a pair of expensive brown leather shoes.
She was wearing a nice black velvet dress.
I lost my small blue plastic bag yesterday.
modelAnswersUz: U chiroyli pushti jun sviter kiygan.
U bir juft qimmat jigarrang charm tufli sotib oldi.
U chiroyli qora baxmal ko'ylak kiygan edi.
Kecha kichkina ko'k plastik sumkamni yo'qotdim.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences with adjectives from the list, in comparative or superlative form. (5 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni ro'yxatdagi sifatlarning qiyosiy yoki eng yuqori darajasi bilan to'ldiring. (5 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
3-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI
(22-betdagi qoida).


⚠ HAR DIALOGDA 'B' AKSINI AYTADI:

  1  A: John is TALLER than Jim.
     B: No, he isn't. He's SHORTER.
     ⚠ 'tall' ning aksi 'short'.

  2  A: This was the CHEAPEST T-shirt.
     B: No, it wasn't. It was THE MOST
        EXPENSIVE!
     ⚠ 'cheap' ning aksi 'expensive';
     ENG YUQORI daraja saqlanadi.

  3  A: The red skirt is the SHORTEST.
     B: You must be joking. It's THE
        LONGEST!
     ⚠ 'short' ning aksi 'long'.

  4  A: Bob is OLDER than you.
     B: Of course he isn't. He's
        YOUNGER!
     ⚠ 'old' ning aksi 'young'.

  5  A: What do you think of Jonson's
        new book?
     B: I thought it was even WORSE
        than his last book!
     ⚠ 'bad' → 'worse' (QOIDASIZ).


⚠ QIYoSIY yoki ENG YUQORI - QAYSI:

  A ning gapidagi ShAKLGA qarang:
     'taller THAN' → qiyosiy → 'shorter'
     'THE cheapest' → eng yuqori →
        'the most expensive'
     'THE shortest' → eng yuqori →
        'the longest'
     'older THAN' → qiyosiy → 'younger'
     — 5-bandda 'even ... THAN' →
        qiyosiy → 'worse'


⚠ 'EVEN' + QIYoSIY DARAJA:

  'even worse' = yanada yomonroq.
  ⚠ 'even' qiyosiy darajani
  KUChAYTIRADI (much, far, a lot kabi).


⚠ 'YOU MUST BE JOKING':

  = hazillashyapsiz shekilli.
  ⚠ 'must' - TAXMIN ma'nosida
  (25-betdagi quti).

items.sentence: A: John is taller than Jim. B: No, he isn't. He's ___ .
items.uz: A: Jon Jimdan baland. B: Yo'q. U pastroq.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'tall' ning aksi - 'short'.
⚠ A ning gapida 'taller THAN' - QIYoSIY daraja,
shuning uchun 'shorter'.

items.sentence: A: This was the cheapest T-shirt in the shop. B: No, it wasn't. It was ___ !
items.uz: A: Bu do'kondagi eng arzon futbolka edi. B: Yo'q. Eng qimmati edi!
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'cheap' ning aksi - 'expensive'.
⚠ 'THE cheapest' - ENG YUQORI daraja, shuning
uchun 'THE MOST expensive' (uzun sifat).

items.sentence: A: The red skirt is the shortest of all. B: You must be joking. It's ___ !
items.uz: A: Qizil yubka hammadan kalta. B: Hazillashyapsiz shekilli. U eng uzuni!
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'short' ning aksi - 'long'.
⚠ 'THE shortest' - ENG YUQORI daraja, shuning
uchun 'THE longEST' (qisqa sifat).
⚠ 'You must be joking' - 'must' TAXMIN ma'nosida.

items.sentence: A: Bob is older than you. B: Of course he isn't. He's ___ !
items.uz: A: Bob sizdan katta. B: Albatta emas. U yoshroq!

items.sentence: A: What do you think of Jonson's new book? B: I thought it was even ___ than his last book!
items.uz: A: Jonsonning yangi kitobi haqida nima deb o'ylaysiz? B: Menimcha, u oldingi kitobidan ham yomonroq edi!
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'bad' → 'WORSE' - QOIDASIZ shakl.
⚠ 'even' qiyosiy darajani KUChAYTIRADI.
⚠ 'than' bor - demak QIYoSIY daraja.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions (1 - 5) to the replies (a - e). (5 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-4-UNITLARDAGI MULOQOT QOLIPLARI.


⚠ HAR SAVOL QAYSI UNITDAN:

  1  ism so'rash - 11-bet, 30-mashq
     ("I didn't catch your name")
  2  transport - 14-bet, 15-mashq
  3  guvoh ko'rsatuvi - 31-bet,
     26-mashq
  4  gul do'koni - 22-bet, 25-mashq
  5  to'lov usuli - 22-bet, 24-mashq


⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI - KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  1  'your NAME' → c: 'Brian, Brian
     Clarke.' (ISM)
  2  'get to WORK' → d: 'I usually go
     BY TRAIN.' (TRANSPORT)
  3  'WHERE were you' → a: 'I was IN
     THE SHOP.' (JOY)
  4  'what FLOWERS' → e: 'Some
     CARNATIONS ... some ROSES.' (GUL)
  5  'pay by CREDIT CARD' → b: 'I'd
     rather pay CASH.' (TO'LOV)


⚠ "I'D RATHER":

  = ... afzal ko'raman.
  ⚠ To'liq: 'I would rather'.
  ⚠ Keyin ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q):
  "I'd rather PAY cash".


⚠ 'A CARNATION':

  = chinnigul.
  ⚠ 22-betdagi 25-mashqda gul do'koni
  dialogi bor edi.


⚠ 'NEXT DOOR TO':

  = ... ning yonidagi.
  ⚠ 'the shop NEXT DOOR TO the bank' =
  bank yonidagi do'kon.
  ⚠ 31-betdagi 26-mashqda 'a burglary
  NEXT DOOR' bor edi.


⚠ 'TO GET TO WORK':

  = ishga yetib bormoq.
  ⚠ 14-betdagi 15-mashqda 'How do you
  get there?' bor edi.

pairs.left: 1  I'm sorry - what did you say your name was?
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kalit so'z: 'your NAME' → javobda ISM.
⚠ 11-betdagi 30-mashqda "I didn't catch your
name" bor edi.

pairs.left: 2  How do you usually get to work?
pairs.right: d  I usually go by train.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kalit so'z: 'HOW ... get to work' → javobda
TRANSPORT.
⚠ 'BY train' - ARTIKLSIZ.

pairs.left: 3  Where were you at the time of the robbery?
pairs.right: a  I was in the shop next door to the bank.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kalit so'z: 'WHERE were you' → javobda JOY.
⚠ 31-betdagi 26-mashq - guvoh ko'rsatuvi.
⚠ 'next door to' = ... yonidagi.

pairs.left: 4  What flowers would you like in your bouquet?
pairs.right: e  Some carnations, please, and perhaps some roses.
pairs.rightUz: e  Chinnigul, iltimos, va balki bir nechta atirgul.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kalit so'z: 'what FLOWERS' → javobda GUL
nomlari.
⚠ 22-betdagi 25-mashqda AYNAN shu dialog bor edi:
'What would you like in it?'

pairs.left: 5  Would you like to pay by credit card?
pairs.right: b  No, thank you. I'd rather pay cash.
pairs.rightUz: b  Yo'q, rahmat. Naqd to'lasam yaxshiroq.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kalit so'z: 'pay by CREDIT CARD' → javobda
TO'LOV usuli.
⚠ "I'd rather" + ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q).
⚠ 22-betdagi 24-mashqda ham 'pay cash' bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the beginning (a) and ending (b) of a story, and put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or past continuous, then answer the questions. (15 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyaning boshlanishi (a) va tugashini (b) o'qing, qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying, so'ng savollarga javob bering. (15 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
TOM RIDLEY HAQIDAGI HIKOYa.

  ⚠ Bu - 4-unitdagi hikoya yozish
  mavzusining tekshiruvi (29 va
  31-betlar).


⚠ QAYSI ZAMON QAYERDA:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (fon va uzun ish):
     2 was blowing (ob-havo - FON)
     3 was walking (uzun ish)
     8 was coming (davom etayotgan
        tovush)

  PAST SIMPLE (voqealar):
     1 was ('be' - HOLAT fe'li)
     4 heard (qisqa ish)
     5 stopped
     6 looked
     7 realised
     9 arrested
     10 turned
     11 said
     12 handed
     13 looked
     14 smiled
     15 replied


⚠ 3 va 4-BANDLAR - 4-UNIT QOLIPI:

  'Tom WAS WALKING to the newsagent's
   WHEN he HEARD a strange noise.'

  ⚠ UZUN ish + QISQA ish -
  29-betdagi 17-mashqning 'c'
  qo'llanishi.


⚠ 8-BAND - 'WAS COMING':

  'the noise WAS COMING from behind
   the door'
  ⚠ Tovush DAVOM etayotgan edi →
  CONTINUOUS.


⚠ 'A DULL MORNING':

  = xira, quyoshsiz tong.
  ⚠ 'dull' yana 'zerikarli' ma'nosida
  ham bo'ladi.


⚠ 'THE NEWSAGENT'S':

  = gazeta do'koni.
  ⚠ 18-betdagi 1-mashqda o'rganilgan.
  ⚠ EGALIK shakli ('shop' tushirilgan).


⚠ 'TO ARREST':

  = hibsga olmoq.
  ⚠ 'the police' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIK
  ma'nosida: 'the police ARREST'
  ('arrests' XATO).


⚠ 'TO HAND SB STH':

  = uzatmoq.
  ⚠ IKKI to'ldiruvchi, predlogsiz.
  ⚠ 20-betdagi 16-mashqda 'to hand sth
  IN' (topshirmoq) bor edi - BOShQA
  ma'no.


⚠ 'A CHEQUE':

  = chek.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'a cheque', AQShda
  'a check'.

lines.speaker: a
lines.en: It 1) ___ (be) a dull Sunday morning and a cold wind 2) ___ (blow) down the empty High Street.
lines.uz: Xira yakshanba tongi edi va bo'sh Bosh ko'chada sovuq shamol esardi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 1: 'be' - HOLAT fe'li → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 2: OB-HAVO tasviri - FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'the High Street' - Britaniyada shaharning
asosiy ko'chasi.

lines.speaker: a
lines.en: Tom Ridley 3) ___ (walk) to the newsagent's to buy his Sunday paper when he 4) ___ (hear) a strange noise.
lines.uz: Tom Ridli yakshanba gazetasini olish uchun gazeta do'koniga ketayotganda g'alati shovqin eshitdi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ UZUN ish (was walking) + QISQA ish (heard) -
29-betdagi 17-mashqning 'c' qo'llanishi.
⚠ "the newsagent's" - 18-betdagi 1-mashqda.
⚠ MAQSAD uchun INFINITIV: 'TO buy'.

lines.speaker: a
lines.en: Tom 5) ___ (stop) and 6) ___ (look) up and down the street, then he 7) ___ (realise) that the noise 8) ___ (come) from behind the heavy iron door of the museum.
lines.uz: Tom to'xtadi va ko'chaning u yoq-bu yog'iga qaradi, keyin shovqin muzeyning og'ir temir eshigi ortidan kelayotganini angladi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 5, 6, 7 - KETMA-KET qisqa ishlar → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 8 - tovush DAVOM etayotgan edi → PAST
CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'stopped' - qisqa unli + bitta undosh →
undosh IKKILANADI.
⚠ 'realised' - Britaniya imlosi.

lines.speaker: b
lines.en: After the police 9) ___ (arrest) the robbers, the owner of the museum 10) ___ (turn) towards Tom.
lines.uz: Politsiya qaroqchilarni hibsga olgach, muzey egasi Tomga o'girildi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Ikkalasi ham KETMA-KET qisqa ish → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'the police' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIK ma'nosida.
⚠ 'to turn TOWARDS sb' - predlog 'towards'.

lines.speaker: b
lines.en: "Please accept this with my thanks," she 11) ___ (say), and 12) ___ (hand) Tom a cheque for £500.
lines.uz: "Iltimos, minnatdorchiligim bilan buni qabul qiling", - dedi u va Tomga 500 funtlik chek uzatdi.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Ikkalasi ham qisqa ish → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'say' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l: say - said - said.
⚠ 'to hand sb sth' - IKKI to'ldiruvchi.

lines.speaker: b
lines.en: Tom 13) ___ (look) at the cheque and 14) ___ (smile) happily. "You're very, very welcome," he 15) ___ (reply).
lines.uz: Tom chekka qaradi va baxtli jilmaydi. "Arzimaydi", - javob berdi u.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Uchalasi ham qisqa ish → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'smile' - 'E' bilan tugagani uchun faqat -D.
⚠ 'reply' - undosh + Y → 'repliED'.
⚠ "You're welcome" = arzimaydi.

exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ SAVOL - HIKOYaNING TAHLILI.

  ⚠ Savollar 29-betdagi 'Beginnings -
  Endings' qutisidagi savollar bilan
  AYNI:
     1  where and when
     2  who
     3-5 what happened
     6  what in the end
     7  how felt
     8  a title


⚠ 8-SAVOL - SARLAVHA O'YLAB TOPISh:

  Yaxshi sarlavha:
     • QISQA (3-5 so'z)
     • asosiy fikrni beradi
     • qiziqish uyg'otadi

  Mumkin variantlar:
     'The Strange Noise'
     'A Lucky Sunday'
     'The Museum Robbery'
     'A Reward for Tom'

  ⚠ 23-betdagi Writing qutisida ham
  aytilgan edi: 'We give the article
  an interesting TITLE to attract the
  reader's attention.'


⚠ SAVOLLARDA ZAMONGA DIQQAT:

  'Where and when DOES the story TAKE
   PLACE?' - PRESENT (hikoyani tahlil
   qilyapmiz)
  'What WAS Tom DOING?' - PAST
   CONTINUOUS
  'What HAPPENED?' - PAST SIMPLE
  'How DID Tom FEEL?' - PAST SIMPLE

  ⚠ 29-betdagi 20-mashqda ham shunday
  edi.

items.prompt: Hikoya qayerda va qachon bo'lib o'tadi?
items.question: Where and when does the story take place?
items.answer: It takes place in the High Street on a dull, cold Sunday morning.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to take place' - PRESENT zamonda, chunki
hikoyani TAHLIL qilyapmiz.
⚠ 'a dull morning' = xira, quyoshsiz tong.

items.question: Who is the main character in the story?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a character' = qahramon (26-betdagi
2-mashqda ham bor edi).
⚠ 'the main character' = bosh qahramon.

items.question: What was Tom doing?
items.answer: He was walking to the newsagent's to buy his Sunday paper.
items.whyUz:
⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - savol ham, javob ham.
⚠ "the newsagent's" - gazeta do'koni.

items.question: What happened?
items.answer: He heard a strange noise. He stopped and looked up and down the street.
items.whyUz:
⚠ PAST SIMPLE - qisqa, ketma-ket ishlar.
⚠ 'to look up and down the street' = ko'chaning
u yoq-bu yog'iga qaramoq.

items.question: What did Tom realise?
items.answer: He realised that the noise was coming from behind the heavy iron door of the museum.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to realise' = anglab yetmoq.
⚠ 'was coming' - tovush DAVOM etayotgan edi.

items.question: What happened in the end?
items.answer: The police arrested the robbers and the owner of the museum gave Tom a cheque for £500.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'in the end' = oxir-oqibat (29-betdagi quti).
⚠ 'the police' - KO'PLIK ma'nosida.

items.prompt: Oxirida Tom o'zini qanday his qildi?
items.question: How did Tom feel in the end?
items.answer: He felt very happy. He smiled happily when he looked at the cheque.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to feel' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l: feel - felt - felt.
⚠ 'happily' - RAVISh ('happy' + -ily).

items.prompt: Bu hikoyaga sarlavha o'ylab topa olasizmi?
items.question: Can you think of a title for this story?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to think OF sth' = o'ylab topmoq.
⚠ Yaxshi sarlavha QISQA bo'ladi va qiziqish
uyg'otadi (23-betdagi Writing qutisi).

exercises.instructionEn: The pictures below show the beginning and ending of a story. Use the prompts to help you write a beginning and ending. (14 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmlar hikoyaning boshlanishi va tugashini ko'rsatadi. Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib boshlanish va tugash yozing. (14 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SURAT - IKKI QISM.


1-SURAT (yig'ilish xonasi) KO'RSATMALARI:

  Friday afternoon - Mr Yang - chairman
  of Sunyang Industries - have staff
  meeting - try - save the company -
  anxious - secretary - Miss Wong say -
  "I think I have the solution."


2-SURAT (guldasta) KO'RSATMALARI:

  Mr Yang - walk in - front door -
  smile - carry - bouquet of flowers -
  "You did it! You saved the company!"
  Miss Wong - smile - "That's all right.
  It's all in a day's work."


⚠ KO'RSATMALARNI GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Ko'rsatmalar QISQA - siz ularni
  to'liq gapga aylantirasiz va
  ZAMONNI to'g'ri tanlaysiz.

  ⚠ FON → past continuous
  ⚠ VOQEA → past simple


⚠ 29 va 31-BETDAGI QOIDA:

  BOShLANISh: qachon, qayerda, kim,
     avval nima bo'ldi
  TUGASh: oxir-oqibat nima bo'ldi,
     odamlar qanday his qildi


⚠ 'IT'S ALL IN A DAY'S WORK':

  = bu odatiy ish, arzimaydi.
  ⚠ Turg'un ibora: qilgan ishini
  KAMTARLIK bilan aytish.
  ⚠ "a day's work" - egalik apostrofi.


⚠ 'A SOLUTION':

  = yechim.
  ⚠ 'to solve' = hal qilmoq.


⚠ 'TO SAVE THE COMPANY':

  = kompaniyani qutqarmoq.
  ⚠ 'to save' yana 'tejamoq',
  'saqlamoq' ma'nosida ham bo'ladi.


⚠ 'YOU DID IT!':

  = uddaladingiz!
  ⚠ 'did' TA'KIDLANGAN - muvaffaqiyatni
  tabriklash iborasi.

structure.modelEn: It was Friday afternoon and Mr Yang, the chairman of Sunyang Industries, was having a staff meeting.
structure.modelUz: Juma kuni tushdan keyin edi va Sunyang Industries raisi janob Yang xodimlar bilan yig'ilish o'tkazayotgan edi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ FON → PAST CONTINUOUS ('was having').
⚠ 'a chairman' = rais (21-betdagi Harrods
matnida ham bor edi).
⚠ IZOh verguller bilan ajratiladi.

structure.modelEn: They were trying to save the company and everyone looked anxious. Suddenly, his secretary, Miss Wong, said, "I think I have the solution."
structure.modelUz: Ular kompaniyani qutqarishga urinishayotgan edi va hamma xavotirli ko'rinardi. To'satdan uning kotibi Miss Vong: "Menimcha, yechimni topdim", - dedi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'were trying' - FON; 'said' - VOQEA.
⚠ 'anxious' - 28-betdagi 15-mashqda.
⚠ 'Suddenly' - voqeani boshlash so'zi.

structure.modelEn: A week later, Mr Yang walked in through the front door. He was smiling and he was carrying a big bouquet of flowers.
structure.modelUz: Bir haftadan keyin janob Yang oldingi eshikdan kirib keldi. U jilmayardi va katta guldasta ko'tarib turgan edi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'walked in' - VOQEA → past simple.
⚠ 'was smiling', 'was carrying' - TASVIR →
past continuous.
⚠ 'the front door' - 27-betdagi 6-mashqda.

structure.modelEn: "You did it! You saved the company!" he said. Miss Wong smiled and replied, "That's all right. It's all in a day's work." Everyone in the office felt very relieved.
structure.modelUz: "Uddaladingiz! Kompaniyani qutqardingiz!" - dedi u. Miss Vong jilmayib javob berdi: "Arzimaydi. Bu oddiy ish". Idoradagi hamma o'zini juda yengil his qildi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ TO'G'RI NUTQ - hikoyani jonli qiladi
(31-betdagi Writing qutisi).
⚠ "It's all in a day's work" - kamtarlik iborasi.
⚠ 'relieved' - 28-betdagi 9-mashqda.

patterns.exampleEn: Tom was walking to the newsagent's when he heard a strange noise.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom gazeta do'koniga ketayotganda g'alati shovqin eshitdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 4-unitning ASOSIY qolipi.
⚠ UZUN ish → continuous; QISQA ish → simple.

patterns.exampleEn: It's a pretty pink woollen jumper.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TARTIB: FIKR → O'LChAM → ShAKL → RANG →
MATERIAL.
⚠ MATERIAL HAR DOIM OXIRIDA.

patterns.exampleEn: John is taller than Jim. - No, he isn't. He's shorter.
patterns.exampleUz: Jon Jimdan baland. - Yo'q. U pastroq.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ A ning gapidagi ShAKLGA qarang:
'-er than' → qiyosiy; 'the -est' → eng yuqori.

patterns.exampleEn: No, thank you. I'd rather pay cash.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "I'd rather" = 'I would rather'.
⚠ Keyin ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q).

patterns.formula: Please accept this with my thanks.
patterns.exampleEn: "Please accept this with my thanks," she said.
patterns.exampleUz: "Iltimos, minnatdorchiligim bilan buni qabul qiling", - dedi u.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Rasmiy minnatdorchilik iborasi.
⚠ 'to accept' = qabul qilmoq; aksi 'to refuse'.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ QIYoSIY VA ENG YUQORI DARAJA - TAKROR
